using PII = pair<int, int>;

const ll MOD2 = 998244353;

mt19937_64 rng(random_device{}());

VI positions[7];
ll prefixSums[7];
ll totalCount;
ll n;
int result;

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll res = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res = (res * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ll modMul(ll a, ll b) {
    return (a % MOD) * (b % MOD) % MOD;
}

ll modAdd(ll a, ll b) {
    return ((a % MOD) + (b % MOD)) % MOD;
}

int queryFixedPrefix(ll fixedPrefix, ll value) {
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int d = 0; d < 7; ++d) {
        ll offset = (value - fixedPrefix * modPow(10, d)) % MOD2;
        if (offset < 0) offset += MOD2;
        auto it = lower_bound(positions[d].begin(), positions[d].end(), MOD2 - offset);
        int idx = it - positions[d].begin();
        ll term = modAdd(modAdd(ans, prefixSums[d]), 
                         modMul(offset, (ll)positions[d].size()));
        term = modAdd(term, MOD2 * ((ll)positions[d].size() - idx));
        ans = (term % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    }
    return ans;
}

void buildPositions(int currentVal, int depth) {
    int x = ((totalCount - currentVal) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
    positions[depth].push_back(x);
    totalCount++;
    prefixSums[depth] = modAdd(prefixSums[depth], x);
    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
        buildPositions(currentVal * 10 + i, depth + 1);
    }
}

void dfsCount(ll currentVal) {
    if (currentVal * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && currentVal * 10000000 > n) {
        result = modAdd(result, queryFixedPrefix(currentVal, totalCount + 1));
        totalCount += (ll)positions[0].size() + (ll)positions[1].size() + 
                      (ll)positions[2].size() + (ll)positions[3].size() + 
                      (ll)positions[4].size() + (ll)positions[5].size() + 
                      (ll)positions[6].size();
    } else {
        totalCount++;
        ll diff = ((totalCount - currentVal) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
        result = modAdd(result, diff);
        for (int i = (currentVal ? 0 : 1); i < 10; ++i) {
            if (currentVal * 10 + i <= n) {
                dfsCount(currentVal * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    buildPositions(0, 0);
    
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; ++i) {
        sort(positions[i].begin(), positions[i].end());

inline i64 modAdd(i64 a, i64 b) {

}

inline i64 modMul(i64 a, i64 b) {
    return ((a % MOD) * (b % MOD)) % MOD;
}

i32 computeQuery(i64 fixedPrefix, i64 value) {
    i64 total = 0;
    for (int digit = 0; digit < 7; ++digit) {
        i64 power10 = modPow(10, digit);
        i64 offset = (value - fixedPrefix * power10) % MOD2;
        if (offset < 0) offset += MOD2;
        auto lb = lower_bound(positions[digit].begin(), positions[digit].end(), MOD2 - offset);
        int index = lb - positions[digit].begin();

        term = modAdd(term, modMul(offset, size));
        term = modAdd(term, MOD2 * (size - index));
        total = term % MOD;
    }
    return (i32)total;

    if (depth == 6) return;
    for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; ++digit) {
        generatePositions(current * 10 + digit, depth + 1);
    }
}

void traverseNumbers(i64 current) {
    i64 lowerBound = current * 1000000 + 999999;
    i64 upperBound = current * 10000000;
    if (lowerBound <= limitN && upperBound > limitN) {
        answer = modAdd(answer, computeQuery(current, totalCounter + 1));
        totalCounter += positions[0].size() + positions[1].size() + 
                        positions[2].size() + positions[3].size() +
